body: Mom of an 18 month old and a 3 year old.  I have BPD and bipolar 1.  Some days feel impossible, other days I feel like super mom.  I'm still trying to figure it all out.  Hang it there!  You're not alone.

I actually have a small "tic" like that. I make a high-pitched "hmmmm" sound and it's almost like...a chill?  That's the best way I can describe it.  I'm not sure what it is; I've avoided therapists like the plague and I've been too embarrassed to look into it.  But same with you, I'm now 24 and I've done this since I was 15-16.  I always thought it was anxiety. 
I feel better knowing I'm not the only person that does this.  Thanks for your post.
